LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_M1A1_RWP.label: Thompson M1A1
LanguageData.Gun_Thompson_M1A1_RWP.description: The Thompson M1A1 is a classic submachine gun known for its high rate of fire and reliability. Designed during World War II, it delivers rapid bursts of .45 caliber rounds, making it ideal for close-quarters combat. This weapon offers a solid balance of power and control, though its effectiveness diminishes over longer distances due to its spread. Known as the "Tommy Gun," it remains a favorite for battles where speed and impact are critical.
